title: Audit revision-bound axis-reduction consumer surface before adding a vector contract

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

objective: Audit concrete Tensor/Fourfold consumers for an existing revision-bound axis-plus-values result owner that could support row/column reduction without inventing a parallel vector abstraction.

authority_boundary.semantic_authority: Forest/Fourfold remain authoritative; Tensor and relation blocks remain regenerable computational views.
forbidden_shortcuts: synthetic Fourfold axis minted only to hold a reduction result

canonical_relation_owner.finding: TypedRelationBlock already owns ProjectionSubject, typed row/column axes, canonical CSR, scalar get/select-style observation, slicing, whole-block scalar reduction, and same-subject composition. Whole-block reduce() returns a scalar observer and does not mint retained derived identity.

tensor_view_owner.finding: TensorView binds repository/source revision plus Forest/Fourfold digests and exposes canonical sparse entries/select(). It does not define a revision-bound vector or axis-plus-values result contract.

public_owner_search.finding: No existing TypedVector/RelationVector/reduce_axis-style canonical owner was found. ProjectionSubject is concentrated in relation_blocks/relation_compiler and their tests/experiments.

concrete_consumers.finding: Backend experiment walks row_offsets/column_indices directly to pack Boolean CSR into row bitmasks; this is physical-backend packing, not a retained revision-bound axis-reduction result.
CUDA probe derives row indices from row_offsets for device packing; this is transport preparation, not a semantic vector consumer.
Operation-count evidence reads row_offsets to count contraction work; it consumes CSR structure directly and does not require an axis-plus-values result object.

gardener_conclusion: Do not add row/column reduction, TypedVector, RelationVector, reduction AST, synthetic collapsed axis, or persistent aggregation owner in this packet. The audited consumers need CSR packing/counting rather than a revision-bound vector result, and no existing canonical result owner can be consolidated. Adding one now would be abstraction-before-consumer. Preserve the smaller scalar-reduction boundary from GPU-143.
evidence_changes: this machine-readable negative Work Packet only
next_bounded_step: GPU-145: audit canonical transpose/reorientation need at existing composition consumers; implement only if it removes repeated CSR reorientation or unlocks a concrete same-subject operation without a new authority/result family.
